description: This Java source file defines a service class 'StreamDataService' that facilitates streaming data between output and input streams in a thread-safe manner, supporting in-memory copy for small data and asynchronous streaming for larger data. It includes nested classes for managing queues and stream operations, using Spring's TaskExecutor for concurrency.

classes.name: StreamDataService
classes.description: A service class for converting and streaming data between OutputStream and InputStream, supporting multi-threaded and in-memory operations.

classes.name: StreamDataService.QueueInputStream
classes.description: A custom InputStream that reads data from a BlockingQueue, with timeout and exception propagation support.

classes.name: StreamDataService.QueueOutputStream
classes.description: A custom OutputStream that writes data into the QueueInputStream's queue, signaling end of stream and handling exceptions.

methods.name: streamData
methods.description: Streams data from a StreamDataWriter into an InputStream, using in-memory buffering for small data or asynchronous queue-based streaming for larger data, executed via TaskExecutor.
